items.title: EHA26: J&J’s multiple myeloma therapies impress with new data
items.summary: New data for Talvey and Tecvayli was presented at the annual meeting as J&J directs its therapies in earlier-line settings.

items.title: Cystic Fibrosis Foundation backs Israeli biotech with $13m to develop inhaled drug
items.summary: SpliSense is currently conducting a Phase IIb trial with its antisense oligonucleotide therapy.

items.title: EHA26: AvenCell’s AVC-201-01 switchable allogeneic CAR T offers early validation in AML
items.summary: AvenCell Therapeutics presented updated results for its CAR-T cell blood cancer therapy at EHA 2026.

items.title: FDA and MHRA forge new regulatory collaboration initiative
items.summary: The new initiative is intended to improve the global oversight of medical devices, AI, and innovative medicines and to streamline knowledge sharing efforts.

items.title: Alkermes’ alixorexton secures FDA and EC orphan designations
items.summary: Alkermes has received ODD from both the FDA and the EC for alixorexton, its investigational OX2R agonist to treat idiopathic hypersomnia and narcolepsy.
